How we build a stone and marble wall

Stone punishes improvisation. A vein that stops mid-wall, a seam that catches the light, a corner that does not wrap - each one stays visible for decades. That is why our process front-loads the planning: full-size layout review with you, slab selection by photo and sample, and cutting done to templates. On site, the work is methodical - reinforced backing, leveled setting, mitered or wrapped corners - and the result is a wall that looks like the house was built around it.

From photo to finished wall

STEP 1 - DESIGN PREVIEW

You send a photo of your room. We design the wall around your space, screen and equipment, and send back a concept with a written estimate.

STEP 2 - MATERIALS & SCHEDULE

STEP 4 - WALKTHROUGH

The first step costs nothing: send the room photo through the form and see your wall designed before you commit to anything.

What Westminster clients ask us

How much does a stone or marble feature wall cost in Westminster?

Stone and marble feature walls in Westminster start at $9,800. Final price depends on wall size, material choice and layout complexity. Porcelain marble-look slabs deliver the same visual result as natural marble at a lower material cost and with far less maintenance - both are quoted in your written estimate.

Is it real marble or porcelain?

Your choice. We install both. Most clients pick large-format porcelain: it is lighter, does not need sealing, and modern prints match marble veining closely enough that guests cannot tell at viewing distance.

How are the seams handled?

Slabs are laid out in advance so veins continue across pieces, seams are kept to 1-2mm and filled with color-matched material. On a finished wall you see the stone, not the grid.

Can stone go around a fireplace?

Yes - fireplace surrounds are one of the most common stone projects. We use heat-rated materials and setting compounds within the fireplace manufacturer's clearances.
